question.text: Unlisted debt securities WITHOUT an ascertainable market are valued at:

answer.text: Amortized Cost plus accrued interest (if any)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.1, unlisted debt without market is valued at amortized cost plus accrued interest. The Trap: Face value or equity-linked metrics are wrong. Cross-Exam Context: Consistent with accounting practice (Ind-AS 109). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Track amortization schedule carefully when rates change mid-period.
